mapper.sql: select d.detail_id, d.check_id, coalesce(d.item_type, 'product') as item_type, coalesce(d.item_id, d.product_id) as item_id, d.product_id, d.product_name, d.product_code, p.category_id as category_id, c.category_name as category_name, ( select group_concat(pc.category_name order by find_in_set(pc.category_id, concat(c.ancestors, ',', c.category_id)) separator ' / ') from inv_product_category pc where pc.del_flag = '0' and find_in_set(pc.category_id, concat(c.ancestors, ',', c.category_id)) > 0 ) as category_full_path, d.unit, d.spec, d.book_qty, d.actual_qty, d.recount_required, d.recount_qty, d.recount_by, d.recount_time, d.diff_qty, d.diff_type, d.cost_price from inv_stock_check_detail d left join inv_product p on p.product_id = d.product_id and coalesce(d.item_type, 'product') = 'product' left join inv_product_category c on c.category_id = p.category_id and c.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where d.check_id = #{checkId} order by d.detail_id asc

select detail_id, check_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, product_name, product_code, unit, spec, book_qty, actual_qty, recount_required, recount_qty, recount_by, recount_time, diff_qty, diff_type, cost_price from inv_stock_check_detail where check_id = #{checkId} order by detail_id asc for update
mapper.insert:
insert into inv_stock_check_detail ( check_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, product_name, product_code, unit, spec, book_qty, actual_qty, recount_required, recount_qty, diff_qty, diff_type, cost_price ) values
( #{item.checkId}, #{item.itemType}, #{item.itemId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.productName}, #{item.productCode}, #{item.unit}, #{item.spec}, #{item.bookQty}, #{item.actualQty}, #{item.recountRequired}, #{item.recountQty}, #{item.diffQty}, #{item.diffType}, #{item.costPrice} )
mapper.update: update inv_stock_check_detail set actual_qty = #{actualQty}, recount_required = #{recountRequired}, recount_qty = #{recountQty}, recount_by = #{recountBy}, recount_time = #{recountTime}, diff_qty = #{diffQty}, diff_type = #{diffType} where detail_id = #{detailId}
update inv_stock_check_detail set cost_price = #{costPrice} where detail_id = #{detailId}

update inv_stock_check_detail set book_qty = #{bookQty}, actual_qty = null, recount_required = '0', recount_qty = null, recount_by = null, recount_time = null, diff_qty = 0, diff_type = 'none', cost_price = #{costPrice} where detail_id = #{detailId}
mapper.select:
select coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') as itemType, coalesce(s.item_id, s.product_id) as itemId, case when coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') = 'product' then s.product_id end as productId, case coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') when 'oe' then oe.oe_item_name when 'gift' then gift.gift_name else p.product_name end as productName, case coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') when 'oe' then oe.oe_item_code when 'gift' then gift.gift_code else p.product_code end as productCode, p.category_id as categoryId, c.ancestors as categoryAncestors, case coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') when 'oe' then oe.order_unit when 'gift' then gift.replenishment_unit else p.unit end as unit, case coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') when 'oe' then oe.item_description when 'gift' then gift.spec else p.spec end as spec, s.current_quantity as currentQuantity, s.cost_price as costPrice from inv_stock s left join inv_product p on coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') = 'product' and p.product_id = coalesce(s.item_id, s.product_id) left join inv_product_category c on c.category_id = p.category_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join inv_oe_item oe on s.item_type = 'oe' and oe.oe_item_id = s.item_id left join inv_gift_box gift on s.item_type = 'gift' and gift.gift_id = s.item_id where s.shop_dept_id = #{shopDeptId} and s.current_quantity <> 0
and s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and s.warehouse_id is null
order by coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') asc, coalesce(s.item_id, s.product_id) asc
